name: Fody Foods Low-FODMAP Tomato Ketchup (No Onion, No Garlic)
whyItWorks: Certified Low-FODMAP by Monash University. Formulated specifically for IBD and IBS patients: made from tomato puree and organic cane sugar with ZERO onion, ZERO garlic, and ZERO high-fructose corn syrup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use freely on burgers, scrambled eggs, and baked potatoes even during sensitive digestion phases.
watchOuts: Mild natural tomato acidity; generally well-tolerated by almost all IBD patients.
